sources.name: NOAA H13093: Vicinity of Anacapa Island
sources.provider: NOAA/NOS Office of Coast Survey; NCEI archive
sources.tidal_epoch: 1983–2001 per final Tide Note in the descriptive report
sources.rights: CC0-1.0, explicit dataset-specific NOAA waiver; not a standalone navigational product
sources.credit: NOAA Ship Rainier; NOAA/NOS Pacific Hydrographic Branch; NOAA NCEI
sources.limitations: Historical 2017 survey, not live bathymetry. Variable 1–16 m cells, with only 1–4 m cells eligible here. The survey report identifies dynamic swirling ridges southwest of West Anacapa; terrain relief does not establish bedrock, individual boulders or current catch abundance. The older substrate interpretation is not ground truth. Source product uncertainty is retained without assigning an unsupported confidence interval.

sources.name: NOAA H13323: Cavern Point to Smugglers Cove
sources.provider: NOAA/NOS Office of Coast Survey; NCEI archive
sources.rights: CC0-1.0, explicit dataset-specific NOAA waiver; not a standalone navigational product
sources.credit: NOAA Ship Fairweather; NOAA/NOS Pacific Hydrographic Branch; NOAA NCEI
sources.limitations: Historical 2019 survey covering part of eastern Santa Cruz Island, not the entire island. Only native 1–4 m cells with finite product uncertainty qualify. Historical substrate interpretation remains uncertain; no individual boulder dimensions, current fish presence or catches are established.

limits: Native 1–4 m gridded depth is not sounding accuracy or an individual rock inventory.
Published habitat ranks are transparent physical proxies, not calibrated bite probabilities.
Original BAG surveys are historical; the 2006 hard/soft substrate interpretation lacks target-specific field validation.
The 2 m planning allowance is not a tide or bottom-current prediction.
MPA/GEA geometry is screened at build time and again by the app; current species seasons and actual trip access are separate.
